At the 2026 Coachella Valley Music and Arts Festival, Justin Bieber headlined a 34-song set on April 12, featuring surprise appearances by Nigerian artist Tems and Wizkid. The artists performed the "Essence (Remix)" together, following Tems' solo performance of "I Think You're Special" with Bieber, marking a significant, high-energy moment for Afrobeats' global presence. Coachella 2026 Performance Highlights: Surprise Appearance: Justin Bieber brought out Wizkid and Tems during his headlining set, which was his major return to live performance. "Essence" Performance: The trio performed the popular "Essence (Remix)" which was a major highlight of the night. Tems' Performance: Tems also performed "I Think You're Special" alongside Bieber, which was highly acclaimed. Setting the Stage: Bieber's set, which included 34 songs, featured a blend of his recent music and, at times, a nostalgic look back at his career, as reported by. Other Collaborations: "Essence" (Remix): Tems, Wizkid, and Justin Bieber collaborated on the remix of "Essence," a song that has been widely celebrated and streamed. Cultural Significance: This performance was seen as a key moment, highlighting the rising influence of Afrobeats on the international stage. The performance was noted for bringing together a blend of global sounds, with Wizkid and Tems' appearance creating a memorable moment at the festival, notes.
